title: What Really Happened at the Oroville Dam Spillway?
summary: Practical Engineering summarizes the 2017 Oroville Dam spillway failure, explaining the engineering details behind the incident. It also discusses how operators and regulators failed to keep downstream residents safe.
why: Pointed to as a detailed engineering walkthrough of a major dam incident, and as a parallel to software failures.

quote.text: Practical engineering has a good detailed walkthrough of what happened at Oroville dam from an engineering perspective
